protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Page reports approved-product schedules of 0.6–1.8 mg SC daily for Victoza or titration to 3.0 mg daily for Saxenda. These refer to labeled commercial medicines, not the research vial. 10 mg + 2 mL bacteriostatic water is reference math; do not equate research-grade vial with approved pens.
